name: Evil Eye Retribution
card_text: When a Spell/Trap Card is activated, while you control an "Evil Eye" monster: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it. If "Evil Eye of Selene" is in your Spell & Trap Zone, this card's activation and effect cannot be negated. You can only activate 1 "Evil Eye Retribution" per turn.
